verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MX publishes an OpenAPI specification and suggests importing it into Postman to explore request and response payloads. That relies on an external tool and a developer building block, not a first-party interactive API reference with runnable examples, so it earns no credit. Nothing in the pack documents a 'try it' console or runnable examples inside MX's own docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
